raw_request: 按既有 AgentTeams 长期目标收敛为最小 MVP relay-first closeout；不创建第二个 goal 或 subscription。
understood_objective: Deliver a minimal relay-first AgentTeams MVP: two real daemons bootstrap through the public Relay, publish and discover a passive capability/resource, complete Agent Work across a public/NAT egress path without Console, persist multi-provider OpenCode configuration with explicit RCC and goaichat instances, and close every delivery unit with exact review, integration, remote push, memory and cleanup evidence.
acceptance_criteria: The Relay-first daemon path is proven on a real public service with at least one daemon behind NAT egress: login, directory, capability/resource publication, matching, Work proposal/request/close and re-login.
A fixed-root passive file-search capability completes real Work; allocation capacity, idempotent duplicate requests, release and stale-generation rejection are proven.

Teams owns multiple provider instances and model catalogs; RCC at 127.0.0.1:4444 and canonical instance goaichat-openai (from the goaichat_openai configuration) are explicit OpenCode provider bindings with catalog/apply/readback and restart persistence; no implicit failover.
All Console processes can exit while Agent Work completes; reopening a Console reads accepted/effective config, Work state and allocation state.

Each delivery unit passes applicable focused/regression gates, exact independent review, integration verification, remote main push, Level 2 memory and owned-resource cleanup; no live direct, full Endpoint, mobile or UI-completeness claim is required for this MVP.
non_goals: Claim runtime readiness from type declarations or unit tests.
Publish to production without deployment authorization.
Create a second goal or subscription.
Require live direct/STUN/ICE or NAT-to-NAT direct in this MVP.
Complete Endpoint E1/E2, master/slave relations, browser multi-profile/mobile replay or full Console/UI polish in this MVP.
Add implicit provider failover, modify upstream providers or disclose credentials.
assumptions: One source admission unit contains existing code; semantic ownership stays in docs/architecture/module-registry.json.
Console is optional and never an Agent-to-Agent transport; passive capability Agents and one-to-many resource semantics remain first-class.
Relay-first public/NAT egress is the MVP transport; direct listener and route contracts remain post-MVP live work.
RCC 4444 is the primary provider and canonical goaichat-openai is an explicit backup instance sourced from goaichat_openai; selection and errors remain visible.
Existing mapped source regression gates remain applicable when their owned paths are affected; post-MVP scope removes only their live acceptance claims.
